name: Illumination
description: Energy saturates the realm. Blaze with divine power.

stages.description: Energy reaches 50% influence in at least 1 region.

conditions.description: Energy sphere influence at 0.5+ in 1+ region

stages.description: Energy reaches 60% influence in at least 2 regions.

conditions.description: Energy sphere influence at 0.6+ in 2+ regions

stages.description: Energy reaches 70% influence in at least 4 regions. The realm burns bright.

conditions.description: Energy sphere influence at 0.7+ in 4+ regions

prose.setup_to_escalation: One region is saturated in energy. Light blazes where shadow held dominion. Power radiates outward in waves of transformation.
prose.escalation_to_culmination: Two territories burn bright with divine power. Energy courses through their bones. The realm begins to remember what radiance means.
prose.completed: Four regions blaze with the force of pure energy. The world is illuminated end to end. Your light has become the only truth. Darkness yields.
prose.failed: The radiance dims and fails. Shadows reclaim their territory. Your light was not steady enough to rewrite the sky.
